headline: Approved four policies on first read, including academic freedom and school day; sent budget items to a subcommittee.
summary: Speakers during public comment urged fair pay and benefits for paraprofessionals. Staff presented an attendance report showing a 43.8% chronic absenteeism rate, and the superintendent gave an update on her entry planning process. Out-of-state travel for L. Clayton-M. Collazo to a conference in San Francisco was approved.
decisions: Approved out-of-state travel for L. Clayton-M. Collazo to attend a conference in San Francisco, October 28 to November 1, 2026; the vote was unanimous.
Referred the FY 2026 and FY 2027 budget adjustments and FY28 budget items to the Finance and Operations Subcommittee; the vote was unanimous.
Accepted the report of warrants and approved the 10.13.26 Warrant Report; the vote was unanimous.
Approved the minutes of the 9.14.26 and 9.28.26 meetings; the vote was unanimous.
Approved the minutes of the 6.25.26 Policy and Governance meeting; the vote was unanimous.
Approved policy IB, Academic Freedom, as a first read; the vote was unanimous.
Approved policy ID, School Day, as a first read; the vote was unanimous.
Approved policy BEDB, Agenda Format, as a first read; the vote was unanimous.
Approved policy FF, Naming Facilities, as a first read, with the word 'new' struck from the title; the vote was unanimous.
